spec_title: ISS Veggie seed film placement into plant pillows

variants.title: Longer packet
variants.summary: The seed film packet grows longer along its axis while staying within jaw limits.

variants.title: Packet starts in pillow
variants.summary: The arm takes the packet out of the plant pillow and puts it back in the same spot.

variants.title: Pillow tray shifted right
variants.summary: The plant pillow tray moves 30 mm to the right, requiring the arm to reach farther.

variants.title: Tighter pillow fit
variants.summary: The pocket clearance reduces to 2 mm, demanding precise placement of the seed film packet.

variants.title: Flatter packet
variants.summary: The seed film packet becomes thinner in height while length and width stay the same.

warnings: super: variant "Longer packet": outside what the robot's jaws and reach hold: objects[obj1].size_mm is [40,10,40] on the bench, not [40,10,45]
